opening.argument: The video presents a Polkadot price prediction and supply analysis as speculative market commentary, not a required investment opportunity. The speaker describes the discussion as public research, discloses his own DOT investment, and leaves viewers to decide whether to invest. The description expressly disclaims financial, investment, and trading advice. Although viewers are invited to make contact by email or Telegram, that invitation does not establish any requirement to pay, invest, provide credentials, or participate under deceptive terms. The observable record supports an educational analysis in which the speaker offers a view while leaving the investment decision with the audience.
